description: This PHP file is a template for editing a 'node' object within an admin panel. It generates an HTML form pre-populated with node data, including fields for name, subtitle, description, various images/logos, and social links, utilizing a NormalForm class to structure the form elements.

classes.name: NormalForm
classes.description: A class used to generate and handle structured HTML forms based on an array configuration.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the current view.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section of content to be injected into the layout.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Outputs the current section, replacing the placeholder in the layout.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves localized or predefined text strings.
